items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15

ctx.x: Yes, I remember. I never heard him on drums. Other people have told me that. They used to hear him on drums. Yeah, I used to get a little job, you know. Get a little work in the cinema. When did you stop playing, Mr. Humphrey? How late did you work on it?

I stopped playing clarinet at the 23-year-old. Frank Lewis taught me. He showed the keys. I was married at 23-year-old. I was married at 23-year-old. I was first to play music at the 19-year-old. I was first to play music at the 19-year-old.
Yeah, I finished here in 19-year-old. Yeah, I finished here in 19-year-old.
